It is a legitimate open source honeypot framework designed to simulate vulnerable HTTP-based applications for security research and threat intelligence gathering. detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: HASH is not malware. No detection is required. If you are looking to detect honeypots in your environment, look for HTTP servers that respond with fake error messages or randomized data, but this is not indicative of malicious activity.
